scope: Castilla y León 2026 - municipality-level resolution of the 392 gaps listed in spanish-holidays-cyl-resolution.json (unresolved array)
method: 1. Re-checked Junta open-data API freshness (still data_processed 2026-02-17; no change).

2. Automated scan of the nine provincial BOP issue indexes (Burgos numbered issues bopbur-2025-185..244 & bopbur-2026-1..180; León announcement slug enumeration Festivos-locales-para-2026-00001..00098; Soria per-date index; Salamanca JSP/Pdf enumeration attempt - not scriptable).
3. Official municipal announcements: 90 BOP León 'Festivos locales para 2026' announcements downloaded and parsed; 10 matched unresolved León municipalities with exact dates + CVEs.
4. Targeted websearch per notable municipality; official municipal sites and BOP pages checked; secondary aggregators used only as labeled non-official leads.
Correction: the only candidate non-official lead (Masueco 37184) is already covered by the API dataset, and its aggregator data does not apply to the 392 gap set; no valid tier-3 leads remain.
